scope: 10 independent homepage design images only; no implementation changes
common_prompt:
Create ONE highly polished, believable Japanese corporate website UI proposal, not a moodboard or a collage of multiple options. Redesign the existing GIGUUU homepage in image 1; the user rejected its current composition. Image 1 is CONTENT/BRAND CONTEXT ONLY, do NOT imitate its huge left-aligned two-line gothic headline with a thin vertical blue line. Image 2 is the actual existing logo: preserve this logo at normal navigation size; its four-leaf silhouette and outward rays may inspire decorative artwork but never invent a story about what its leaves represent. Image 3 is the PRIMARY VISUAL REFERENCE: borrow the specified design technique only, not its people, products, wording, logo or palette. Ignore all browser chrome in screenshots.
Output one flat front-on desktop webpage design, 1440px wide x 1920px tall (3:4 aspect ratio), showing header, complete hero and complete ABOUT US section. This is a top-of-homepage scroll capture: the remaining original sections continue below the frame and are not deleted. No device bezel, browser UI, presentation title, option number, comparison grid, annotations or watermark.
Fixed palette: predominantly PURE WHITE (at least 70% of the surface); blue #5B9BFF and orange #FF8A3D accents; near-black #0B1220 readable text, deep blue #225FB9 for text where needed; subtle very pale blue surfaces allowed. Original small multicolor logo is the only other-color exception. Keep orange for the principal action. No dark full-width section.
The site's purpose is to explain the sales-origin AI company and lead visitors to business.html or the contact area. No photos are available. Do not invent any humans, team photography, buildings, AI robots, physical products, charts, testimonials, customer logos, app screens, dashboards, percentages, achievements or business facts. Use authentic words, typography, existing logo-derived shapes and custom editorial illustration as specified. No stock 3D icons, arbitrary glowing balls, default blue-purple gradients, generic SaaS card grids. Design should feel distinctive and professionally buildable, with coherent header, intentional whitespace and a recognizable first view. Body 16-18px, legible Japanese. At most two type families.
Every proposal MUST show exactly the same following content, without paraphrasing, extra labels or deletions. Use natural Japanese line breaks. Rendering accurate Japanese text is essential:
HEADER: small provided logo, "GIGUUU 株式会社"; navigation "GIGUUUとは" "会社情報" "事業紹介" "TELEMO" "お問い合わせ".
HERO EYEBROW: "▸ ABOUT GIGUUU".
MAIN HEADLINE: "人の限界を、技術で超えていく".
HERO PARAGRAPH: "現場を知る、AIの会社。営業会社発のテクノロジーで、属人化していた“勝ちパターン”を、誰もが使える仕組みに変える。".
HERO ACTIONS: orange primary "事業を見る" with arrow; secondary text link "お問い合わせ".
HERO SUPPORT: "AI" "×営業" "現場発の技術"; "04" "DOMAINS" "事業領域"; "SCROLL".
ABOUT SECTION LABEL: "01" "ABOUT US".
ABOUT HEADLINE: "現場を知る、AIの会社。".
ABOUT PARAGRAPH 1: "私たちGIGUUUは、エンジニア発ではなく営業会社発のAIカンパニーです。数百万件を超えるコールデータと、現場で磨かれた営業ノウハウ。その両方を知るからこそ、机上ではない“効く”AIをつくれる。".
ABOUT PARAGRAPH 2: "技術のための技術ではなく、現場の課題から逆算したプロダクト。それがGIGUUUの出発点です。".
Respect the full text. Provide enough vertical space. Do not fabricate any missing content.
Art direction for this independent proposal:

concepts.direction: White Brand Stage. Adapt miSignal's dominant central brand/product focus and confident supporting information band into a PHOTO-FREE GIGUUU identity stage. Hero is a spacious horizontal panorama with the complete main headline at upper left in restrained 60px contemporary Japanese serif, a single oversize sculptural four-leaf form derived exactly from the actual logo occupying the right-center, rendered as crisp WHITE relief with a thin BLUE cut edge and natural restrained shadow. It is decorative brand artwork, not a product. Main paragraph and CTA form one considered lower-left group, with the existing two support facts placed in an elegant horizontal base strip. No vertical boundary line. ABOUT begins with a huge blue '01' and compact asymmetric text columns. Overall premium light, tactile, serene; strong asymmetric silhouette, not a generic split SaaS hero.

Monogram Architecture. Adapt Financial Japan's oversized letterform-as-image-window idea. White canvas with a monumental custom outlined G occupying the right two-thirds of the HERO; broad blue typographic edges and white negative space, grounded in the actual GIGUUU name. No photographs or invented UI inside the letter. The complete headline in smaller 52px sharp Japanese gothic occupies upper-left, with the last phrase entering the G's open white counter without crossing the blue shape. A slim left-aligned editorial column carries paragraph and orange CTA; AI and 04 support facts are anchored across a quiet bottom rule. Header is very spare and compact. ABOUT is a different rigorous two-column editorial spread with the title on the right and paragraphs on the left. Crisp geometric and architectural, absolutely no floating colored blobs.

Human Handwritten Emphasis. Adapt MANY PEOPLE's deliberate mix of stable print and one expressive handwritten word, and its human warmth, without using any person photograph. Hero headline is a broad, relaxed central typographic composition around mid-screen: most words in clear medium-weight Japanese gothic, only the EXISTING word '人' rendered in bespoke blue confident brush script. Do not add new words. Very pale blue logo-leaf silhouettes at the far edges create soft organic whitespace rather than a rectangle or straight vertical line. Paragraph below left, orange primary CTA offset to the right on the SAME horizontal baseline, facts in a low-density quiet row. Lower ABOUT uses generous margin notes and rounded, humane typography; one existing '現場' word may be underlined with a small blue hand-drawn stroke. Friendly, calm, sophisticated corporate personality, not childish or cartoonish.

Knowledge Paper Assembly. Adapt Sunshine City's single highly art-directed assemblage and diagonal movement, replacing all travel objects and seasonal items with GIGUUU's authentic typography and FOUR-LEAF LOGO silhouettes. Create a sophisticated flat editorial white-paper composition: a large white paper plane tilted only 3 degrees hosts the full exact headline, with two smaller pale-blue and white paper planes carrying the existing hero paragraph and two support facts. Blue paper edges and restrained real shadows, orange only in the clear CTA; headline remains perfectly readable, not cut into nonsense. The assemblage is one coherent hero illustration placed right-of-center, while the actual usable primary/secondary actions sit on a calm horizontal rail below. Never add made-up notes, labels or stationery. ABOUT returns to a very orderly wide white two-column reading layout. Energetic, crafted, tactile, with 70% white.

Transparent Clover Layers. Adapt ELIXIR's refined Japanese serif typography, light and translucent layering, without borrowing cosmetics or violet colors. A beautiful extremely thin translucent glass four-leaf outline derived from the GIGUUU logo sits centrally on pure white and casts a subtle pale BLUE caustic; no arbitrary sphere. The full headline appears in elegant crisp 64px Japanese Mincho in a quiet LEFT-aligned group inside the broad white counterspace, with large airy line spacing. The small paragraph is anchored toward bottom right, CTA bottom left, so the total composition has a graceful diagonal balance and room to breathe. Facts are tiny but legible at the lower baseline. ABOUT is restrained: narrow centered editorial prose with an offset blue section number and strong serif subheading. This is identity artwork, not a glass product, no lab claims or scientific diagrams.

Letterpress Close-up. Adapt Haagen-Dazs' extreme close-up on tactile material and large visual storytelling, but replace its food photography with the EXISTING Japanese headline as exquisitely crafted blue letterpress on a white paper stage. The full headline stays completely readable and NOT cropped: two substantial rows of embossed blue type in the HERO's upper two-thirds, viewed front-on with just enough shallow shadow to feel tangible; not metallic chrome and not a wall of giant default sans text. Use strong editorial Japanese serif, sculptural but refined. Header occupies a tidy white band. Put the entire hero paragraph, CTA and two support facts in a single disciplined bottom strip. ABOUT uses close typographic scale contrasts and a broad left margin, with every paragraph readable. Signature is tactile typesetting, not a generic 3D object or product.

AI Sales Intersection. Adapt miSignal's clear focal hierarchy and separated supporting facts into a typographic identity diagram using ONLY the existing 'AI' and '×営業'. A large immaculate blue 'AI' and near-black '営業' intersect once around a modest orange '×' at the center-right of a mostly white HERO, an editorial word composition, NOT a workflow or data diagram. Avoid adding an additional duplicate AI stat: use this composition as the existing AI support item and place its original '現場発の技術' beneath. Full primary headline in a calm 54px gothic upper-left block; paragraph and CTA underneath, with the existing 04 DOMAINS support fact at lower-right. ABOUT below is a clean unequal-width layout, headline centered vertically left and both paragraphs right, subtle horizontal lines. Contemporary, transparent, confident, no giant vertical boundary and no dashboard.

Vertical Editorial Voice. A distinctly JAPANESE VERTICAL TYPOGRAPHIC hero on pure white, adapting MANY PEOPLE's expressive word emphasis and readable human-centered rhythm. Place the full original main headline in two carefully set vertical Japanese columns in the right third, read right-to-left, with '技術' in a bespoke blue handwritten style while all other characters are refined dark gothic. This is the main visible hero protagonist; no rotated horizontal text. In the left half put the full paragraph in ordinary horizontal Japanese and a single orange CTA below. Existing AI/04 support facts occupy a quiet narrow band along the bottom. One oversized pale blue contour derived from ONE of the logo's clover leaves gently frames the empty central space without becoming a stock blob. ABOUT switches to horizontal composition with broad top whitespace and asymmetric baseline alignment. Highly editorial, confident, mature; no decorative pseudo-kanji.

White Aperture Identity. Adapt Financial Japan's giant identity-shaped window, but invert it. The page is predominantly white with a single LARGE PALE-BLUE square hero field offset left, cut through by a monumental WHITE four-leaf aperture based precisely on the GIGUUU logo. Deep blue thin contour and high-contrast headline sit in the white aperture; the rest of the complete headline continues into white page space to its right, always readable in one natural sequence. Use the hero paragraph and CTA in a distinct narrow right column below the headline, not over the artwork. Preserve the two support facts in a quiet row. About section uses a wide clean publication grid and small repeated leaf-cut corner detail. This is a bold negative-space design with a soft logo-derived shape and precise geometry, not line-drawn clover and not a clone of the current hero.

Folded Continuous Story. Adapt Sunshine City's cohesive crafted collage and storytelling from top to bottom. Design ONE large pristine white page-fold ribbon that descends through the hero into ABOUT, with BLUE visible only on the narrow folded underside; it is a typographic page architecture, not a floating generic ribbon. The main headline is compact but powerful in the UPPER RIGHT, the hero paragraph occupies a substantial central LEFT reading panel, the orange CTA anchors the central bottom with clear spacing, and the two real support facts align across the fold's landing. Header stays simple. ABOUT visibly continues on the same unfolded white sheet: its existing title set large at left, full prose on the right. Interesting diagonal fold in the central negative space, but all actual text is horizontal and perfectly readable. White-dominant, crafted and editorial; no tiny clutter, no added labels.
